name: domain.log_forensics
description: High-throughput SIEM log stream parser, anomaly detection, and incident timeline reconstructor

entrypoints.name: parse_log_stream
entrypoints.description: Parse raw text log stream (Syslog, JSONL, Apache/Nginx, or standard key-value) into structured records

entrypoints.name: detect_log_anomalies
entrypoints.description: Detect attack patterns (brute force, 4xx/5xx spikes, privilege escalation, suspicious IPs) in parsed logs

entrypoints.name: build_incident_timeline
entrypoints.description: Sort and synthesize a chronological incident timeline with severity tagging
